_comment: NPC-against-NPC fights (npc.rs Kind::Fighter), hand-made and INFERRED: live placements were server-side. Remembered from live: knights fought in the Medieval Kingdom, and ghost pirates fought the navy at the start of the Isle of Yarr. Per playfield: replace_anchors = proposed enemy camps of world_content.json (by anchor) this replaces, enemies = hostile NPCs added, rivals = sides of enemies (by monsterdata) that attack each other, fighters = friendly NPCs that fight the enemies near them, armed_npcs = names of the playfield's friendly NPCs (world_content.json) that fight the enemies near them too (players can't attack them; they respawn like enemies). npc_template = the server's NPC template id, which is the NPC's name id in TDB 51000 (as every recorded NPC's: Scallywag 1710/1711, Musketeer 851, Tavern Pirate 1033-1035): Pirate Specter 933/934, the navy block 898-901 (Medic, Dragoon, Musketeer, Commodore Moksey; separate from the hostile Jackets' recorded Musketeer 851, hence taken for the friendly navy), Knight of the Crown 1342. Looks: the client's dialogue actor templates (RDB 1000620, dynel type 30035) carry MonsterData stat 359: Jacket Officer 198601 -> 192827 pirate_officer (Commodore Moksey; the Dragoon's look is a guess), Jacket Guard 198602 -> 192826 pirate_musketeer, Knight of the Crown 462490/462491 -> 352446/352447 medieval_npc_knight_a/b. Ghost pirates: skeleton_pirate_1/2 (207001/207030, the tutorial's recorded ghost Scallywags). Positions: on the navmesh (RDB 1000051) next to the proposed camps; levels/health as the world's regular enemies (60 + 15 x level). See docs/TUNABLES.md.

4200.about: Landing Beach (bounded area Quest_Beach, ~50 m from the arrival point; quest 'Push back the Ghost Pirates'): the proposed Jacket/pirate camp there becomes ghost pirates, the Imperial navy ('Jackets': Commodore Moksey, a Dragoon, two Musketeers) fights them
4200.rivals_about: ghost pirates (skeleton_pirate_1/2) and the hostile Jackets (red coats: pirate_musketeer, pirate_medic, pirate_officer) attack each other wherever they meet; a ghost group is added next to the Jackets (a Dragoon, two Musketeers) the live server had at (111, 101) near Res_JacketBridge (10-11 m away) so they meet there

5200.about: outside the town gate (bounded areas Quest_Siege, BA_Head_Trolls1, BA_SiegeCatapult1): Knights of the Crown fight the proposed troll siege camp; the story Knight at the gate (Cine_KnightSpawn2) fights the proposed camp next to it (BA_CastleAmbush1)
